# Pixel Clicker Game

A simple offline browser-based clicker game. Click the coin to earn points, buy auto-clicker upgrades to generate passive income.

## Features

- Click the coin (or press Space/Enter) to earn 1 point per click.
- Buy auto-clicker upgrades for 10 points initially; price doubles with each purchase.
- Each auto-clicker generates 1 point per second.
- Real-time display of points, upgrade count, and next upgrade price.
- Responsive design works down to 360px width.
- Keyboard accessible controls with visible focus states.

## How to Run

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. No server or internet connection required.

## Controls

- **Coin button**: Click or press Space/Enter to earn points.
- **Buy Auto-clicker button**: Click to purchase an upgrade when you have enough points.

## Files

- `index.html` – Game structure
- `styles.css` – Styling and layout
- `script.js` – Game logic
